scope.geometry: Evaluate the untrimmed cone-surface locus under an explicit local parameterization
scope.parameterization: O + (R + v*sinAngle) * (cos(u)*M + ratio*sin(u)*N) + v*cosAngle*A; A is normalized axis, M is normalized projected major axis, N=normalize(A cross M), and R is projected major-axis magnitude
scope.domain: Finite decoded cone face; finite u and signed v; positive finite ratio; positive cosine half-angle; normalized sine/cosine within caller frame tolerance; nondegenerate axis and major-axis frame
scope.tolerance_policy: Caller-supplied finite nonnegative dimensionless tolerance bounds both normalized major-axis axial residual and sine/cosine norm residual; no ACIS/modeler default inferred
scope.numeric_policy: Each of six coordinate terms is represented as a binary mantissa/exponent; terms are accumulated at a shared exponent with compensated summation; reject unrepresentable final coordinates and preserve output on refusal
non_claims: normative ACIS cone ratio or native parameterization semantics
edge trims, pcurves, face bounds, or surface projection
B-rep validity, manifoldness, or shell closure
native consumer or independent-kernel semantic qualification

source.reference_reviewed: ACadRust's current typed accessor/source documents the cone-surface field positions, ratio as minor-to-major, and writer reference-radius convention; the writer is mutable and same-lineage implementation corroboration. Open CASCADE documents the circular conical-surface equation used as a cross-check when ratio=1. Altair documents a minor/major ellipse ratio for a cone API. None is normative ACIS evidence for this exact SAB profile, and no independent geometry kernel was run; the formula is therefore exposed as an explicit local contract only.
